author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

Adds to the PyTorch backend the check that @gsokmen suggested in #51958 for the ONNX backend.

An `SOA_EIGEN_COLUMN` stores the coefficients in the storage order of the Eigen type, while `TensorHandle` computes the strides for column-major storage: reject row-major matrices at compile time. Vectors have the same layout in both storage orders, and are still accepted.

Test that `add()` rejects row-major matrices and accepts column-major matrices and row vectors, and that a row vector is converted correctly.

#### PR validation:

Unit tests pass.
title: Reject row-major Eigen matrices in PyTorchAlpaka
